newsitem.title: USA: Sioux Falls cattle $1.00-1.50 lower - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Sioux Falls cattle $1.00-1.50 lower - USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers traded slow at midday. Compared to last Wednesday, both classes $1.00 lower, instances 1.50 lower - USDA
Slaughter Steers: High Select and Choice 2-3 1150-1350 lbs 62.50-64.00. Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1300 lbs 61.50-62.50. Select 1-2 60.50-61.50.
Slaughter Heifers: High Select and Choice 2-3 1025-1150 lbs 62.50-64.00. Select and Choice 2-3 950-1100 lbs 61.50-62.50. Select 1-2 60.00-61.50.
